symptom: `call rest service … (Body: BINARY $File)` with $File a FileDocument passed check and exec, and mx check reported CE0117 at the Call REST service activity; `BINARY $File/Contents` builds.
file: mdl/exprcheck/target_kind.go checkBinaryTarget (BinaryBodySlot); mdl/exprcheck/adapters/check.go RestCallStmt. Test: mdl/exprcheck/binary_body_2409_test.go
cause: The REST call's binary body expression was never type-checked, and the target-kind rule only compared primitives on both sides.
insight: **Scope a new target rule to the slot that was measured.** Measured on 11.12.6 one microflow per variant (mx check names the activity, not the microflow, so a combined run cannot attribute errors): Contents and empty build; the object, a String literal and a String member are CE0117. A Binary declare/set/return was not measured and an existing test pins it silent, so the rule keys on the slot, not on the Binary target. exec's preflight does not type an object variable, so check with -p reports it and exec still writes it.
